<?php
class MyClass {
    public $prop = 'value';
    private $private = 'secret';
    protected $protected = 'hidden';
    
    public function __construct($arg = 'default') {
        $this->prop = $arg;
    }
    
    public function method($x) {
        return $x * 2;
    }
    
    public static function staticMethod() {
        return 'static';
    }
    
    public function __toString() {
        return $this->prop;
    }
    
    public function __get($name) {
        return "Getting $name";
    }
    
    public function __set($name, $value) {
        echo "Setting $name to $value\n";
    }
    
    public function __call($name, $args) {
        return "Calling $name";
    }
    
    public static function __callStatic($name, $args) {
        return "Static calling $name";
    }
}

interface MyInterface {
    public function interfaceMethod();
}

trait MyTrait {
    public function traitMethod() {
        return 'trait';
    }
}

abstract class MyAbstract {
    abstract public function abstractMethod();
}

class MyDerived extends MyAbstract implements MyInterface {
    use MyTrait;
    
    public function abstractMethod() {
        return 'implemented';
    }
    
    public function interfaceMethod() {
        return 'interface implemented';
    }
}

function testGenerator() {
    yield 1;
    yield 2;
    yield 3;
}

function testVariadic(...$args) {
    return array_sum($args);
}

$obj = new MyClass('test');
echo $obj->method(5) . "\n";
echo MyClass::staticMethod() . "\n";
echo $obj . "\n";
echo $obj->undefinedProp . "\n";
$obj->newProp = 'new';
echo $obj->undefinedMethod() . "\n";
echo MyClass::undefinedStatic() . "\n";

$derived = new MyDerived();
echo $derived->abstractMethod() . "\n";
echo $derived->interfaceMethod() . "\n";
echo $derived->traitMethod() . "\n";

foreach (testGenerator() as $val) {
    echo $val . "\n";
}

echo testVariadic(1, 2, 3, 4, 5) . "\n";

try {
    throw new Exception('Test exception', 42);
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage() . " " . $e->getCode() . "\n";
}

$arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
$result = array_filter($arr, fn($x) => $x > 2);
$result2 = array_map(fn($x) => $x * 2, $arr);
$result3 = array_reduce($arr, fn($c, $x) => $c + $x, 0);

echo json_encode($result) . "\n";
echo serialize($result2) . "\n";
echo hash('sha256', 'test') . "\n";
echo date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "\n";

echo "DONE\n";
?>
